items.s: Swipe through three intro screens, fill in five profile details, and you're ready to log.
p: Swipe through the intro and tap start on the last screen.
Enter a nickname, your sex, birth year, height, and weight.
Enter your estimated squat 1RM. If you don't know it, choose that you're not sure.

items.b: Moving to a new phone Between phones on the same system, use sync or a device backup. Between iPhone and Android, use a backup file. On your old phone, tap Menu → Transfer & backup → Create backup file. Send the file to your new phone by messenger, email, or cloud storage. On the new phone, open it with Menu → Transfer & backup → Import backup file. Choose Replace. On the same system, just turning on sync across devices is enough. If device backup (iCloud Backup or Google's automatic backup) is on, your records also come along when you restore the app on a new device. Subscriptions don't move

items.b: Creating a backup file Menu → Transfer & backup → Create backup file puts all your records into one file. It's free. It includes workouts, routines, schedules, body records, photos, and settings. You can add a password, but a forgotten password means the file can't be opened, so write it down.

items.s: Pick a .fitboost file in Menu → Transfer & backup → Import backup file, then choose replace or merge.
items.k: import restore load replace merge combine overwrite undo
items.b: Importing a backup file Pick a .fitboost file in Menu → Transfer & backup → Import backup file, then choose replace or merge. Replace (free): clears this device's records and replaces them with the file. Your previous records are backed up automatically so you can undo. Merge (PRO): adds the file to your current records. When both have the same record, the one edited last wins, and records deleted on one side come back.
